svg.text: Step 1: 3D CMB candidate detection network (anisotropic 3D U-Net)
(1x)3x3 conv + instance norm + LeakyReLU, twice; level 1 in-plane only
Step 2 (optional, -cand_disc True): candidate discrimination, teacher-student as in MicrobleedNet
CE loss; soft labels at T = 4
Knowledge distillation: CE + 0.4 T^2 KL + 0.6 CE
score threshold chosen out of fold
Blocks: 3x3x3 conv + batch norm + ReLU; fully connected layers with 20 % dropout. Alternative: --disc_model cnn (small 3D CNN, image + FRST + probability).
